questions.stem: What is the main reason atoms form chemical bonds?

options.text: To increase the number of electrons they have
To achieve a stable electron configuration with a full outer shell
To become larger and heavier atoms
To release energy stored in the nucleus

questions.explanation: Atoms form chemical bonds to achieve a more stable electron configuration. The most stable configuration is having a full outer shell of electrons, like the noble gases.

questions.stem: What type of bonding would you expect in a compound formed between magnesium and chlorine?

options.text: Covalent bonding, because both elements are non-metals
Metallic bonding, because magnesium is a metal
Ionic bonding, because magnesium is a metal and chlorine is a non-metal
Covalent bonding, because electrons are shared between atoms

questions.explanation: Ionic bonding occurs between metals and non-metals. Magnesium is a metal and chlorine is a non-metal, so they form an ionic bond through the transfer of electrons.
